Cost: 2,500eb (Very Expensive)
Class: EQ Machine Gun
Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Everything it fires also counts as Explosive ammo, without the -2 to hit. An Autofire attack that beats the DV by only 1 still gets x2. Reloading takes 2 Reload Actions. Unmounted, BODY under 10 means -2 MOVE while wielded, and BODY under 12 means Torn Muscle when firing Autofire or Suppressive Fire. A Nomad may take this weapon when first installing a Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
